name: Standard Clinical Information-System Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent operations against a clinical information system: which record/ordering/prescribing/administering capabilities are authorized, and their parameter bounds (dose ceiling) and allowed sets (department, ward, drug class, patient pseudonym). Categorical identifiers are encoded per CLC-v1 §6.2 (v1.1) as allowed-set ARRAYS in grants: {"drug-class":["narcotic"]} grants ONLY narcotic-class medication. Ordered quantities are encoded as scalar number UPPER BOUNDS: {"dose":10}. Scheme-scoped constraint types declared by this scheme: clinical:quorum:2 (high-risk dual-person confirmation). Unknown constraint types fail closed with deny("unknown_constraint") per CLC-v1 §8.
author: varwof (open ecosystem)
note: IMPORTANT: This authorization layer defines the OPERATION BOUNDARY for an AI agent inside a clinical information system. It is NOT a clinical decision mechanism, does not replace prescription review, medication administration management, or medical-safety regulation, and does not constitute a medical device or a clinical functional-safety measure. It carries NO patient identity data; patient references are grant-scoped pseudonyms only, kept to the minimum necessary.

capabilities.summary: List/read records under a grant-scoped patient pseudonym and department
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted with broad department sets or real patient identifiers

patient.description: grant-scoped pseudonym/internal ID only; never real identity data

capabilities.summary: Create a lab order for a grant-scoped patient in a department/ward
capabilities.usage: Standard lab panels ordered by agents on behalf of clinical staff
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted without an explicit department and ward allowlist

capabilities.summary: Create an imaging order within department/ward bounds
capabilities.usage: Radiology orders by agents under supervision
capabilities.when_not: Must not grant broad ward coverage; imaging is high-cost and high-attention

capabilities.summary: Create a prescription within drug-class allowlist and dose ceiling
capabilities.usage: Medication orders; every grant MUST constrain drug-class and dose
capabilities.when_not: HIGH-RISK: narcotic/psychotropic classes must be single-class grants; dose must always be bounded; grants must normally carry clinical:quorum:2

capabilities.summary: Authorize infusion administration with dose ceiling and ward/class bounds
capabilities.usage: Infusion start for an in-patient under agent guidance
capabilities.when_not: HIGH-RISK: always requires bounded dose, single ward, and normally clinical:quorum:2

capabilities.summary: Append a structured note to a grant-scoped patient record
capabilities.when_not: Must not be granted for unsigned or unaudited note streams

capabilities.summary: Aggregate queries over de-identified records within department bounds
capabilities.when_not: Must never be granted with patient-scoped parameters; only aggregate de-identified scopes
